literal_meaning: লেজযুক্ত বা লেজের মতো লম্বা (tail-like or with tails)
similar_in_english: String of letters after one's name
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নামের শেষে এত লেজুড় যে সত্যি পরিচয় বোঝা যায় না।
আজকাল লেজুড় ছাড়া কেউ বড়লোক বলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His name has so many suffixes that you can't tell his real identity.
Nowadays, without a bunch of titles, no one is considered important.
note: Refers to elongated suffixes in names, common in bureaucratic or professional contexts in Bengal
